title: RNA Isolation from Plant Tissue Using CTAB/Acid Phenol/Silica Membrane Method
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4yfgxtn
materials: Grind tissue to a powder in liquid nitrogen.
Estimate the new total volume in the tube.
Discard the flow-through from the collection tube.

steps.title: Initial Tissue Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from frozen plant tissue using pre-heated extraction buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 mg – 600 mg of ground, frozen tissue to 1.4 mL of pre-heated extraction buffer in a 2 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Vortex the tube until the tissue is mixed with the buffer; if necessary, invert the tube on the vortex or heat briefly in a 65 °C water bath to facilitate mixing.
Incubate the tube at 65 °C for 00:10:00 – 00:15:00, vortexing briefly (15 seconds) twice during the incubation.
Spin the tube at maximum speed for 00:03:00 in a microcentrifuge to pellet insoluble matter.

steps.title: First Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol Wash
steps.instruction: Perform the first organic phase separation to remove chlorophyll.

substeps.instruction: Pour the supernatant into a new 2 ml tube.
Add enough 24:1 chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to fill the tube.
Vortex for 00:00:15 or until the phases mix and appear cloudy.
Spin at maximum speed for 00:03:00 in a microcentrifuge.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 ml tube using a disposable pipette, avoiding the white precipitate at the phase boundary.

steps.title: Second Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a second organic phase separation to further purify the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add at least 900 µL of 24:1 chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to the tube containing the aqueous phase.
Vortex for 00:00:15 or until the phases mix and appear cloudy.
Spin at maximum speed for 00:03:00 in a microcentrifuge.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 ml tube using a disposable pipette, avoiding the white precipitate at the phase boundary.

steps.title: Acid Phenol Extraction
steps.instruction: Use acid phenol to remove proteins and contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL 5:1 phenol:chlorofom pH 4.5 to the tube containing the aqueous phase.
Vortex for 00:00:15 or until the phases mix and appear cloudy.
Spin at maximum speed for 00:03:00 in a microcentrifuge.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 ml tube using a disposable pipette, avoiding the white precipitate at the phase boundary.

steps.title: Third Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a final organic phase separation.

substeps.instruction: Add at least 900 µL of 24:1 chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to the tube containing the aqueous phase.
Vortex for 00:00:15 or until the phases mix and appear cloudy.
Spin at maximum speed for 00:03:00 in a microcentrifuge.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 ml tube using a disposable pipette, avoiding the white precipitate at the phase boundary.

steps.title: RNA Binding to Silica Membrane
steps.instruction: Bind the nucleic acids to a Qiagen miniRNA spin column.

substeps.instruction: Estimate the volume of the aqueous phase based on the tube markings.
Pour the contents of the tube into a Qiagen miniRNA spin column (pink) until the column is almost filled.
Cap the tube and spin for 00:00:15 at maximum speed.
Repeat the pouring and spinning process until all liquid has passed through the column.

steps.title: Membrane Washing and DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane and remove contaminating DNA.

substeps.instruction: Apply 350 µL of solution RW1 to the spin column and spin for 00:00:15 at maximum speed.
Apply 80 µL of DNase digestion solution to the membrane and incubate at room temperature for 00:15:00.
Apply 350 µL of solution RW1 to the spin column and spin for 00:00:15 at maximum speed.

steps.title: Final Membrane Washes
steps.instruction: Perform final washes to remove salts and reagents.

substeps.instruction: Apply 500 µL of solution RPE to the spin column and spin for 00:00:15 at maximum speed.
Apply another 500 µL of solution RPE to the spin column and spin for 00:00:15 at maximum speed.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new collection tube, then to a new 1.5 ml conical bottom microcentrifuge tube.
Add 44 µL of RNase-free water to the column.
Spin at maximum speed for 00:01:00 to elute.

steps.title: Post-Elution Processing
steps.instruction: Perform final cleanup steps if required.

substeps.instruction: Add at least 0.5 volumes of solution RLT and mix by briefly shaking.
Add 0.5 volumes of 95–100 % ethanol and mix by briefly shaking.
Spin at maximum speed for 00:03:00 to remove remaining liquid from the silica membrane.
